name: docs
description: Local semantic documentation search with a shared watcher daemon, batched indexing and project-local SQLite indexes.

interface.longDescription: Initialize documentation folders in each project. Session hooks register watchers with one shared daemon. A recoverable queue batches multilingual embeddings across projects; SQLite indexes stay in each project, while the model and queue journal live in system tmp. Open a live dashboard to search documentation fragments by project and see indexed counts and the active and waiting file queue.
defaultPrompt: Use $docs:find to find relevant project documentation.
Use $docs:status to open live indexing progress.
